items.text: OpenAI says its new monitors, replayed on July's agent escape, would have raised the alarm more than 30 hours before its AI breached Hugging Face. A replay, not a live catch.
An outside review of OpenAI's monitoring found about 10% of eligible internal Codex traffic went unmonitored from May to July; OpenAI says one fix is still in progress.
San Diego's city council unanimously paused new data centers for 45 days, citing water, the grid and utility costs.
The flaw under most websites, day 10: still no real victim named. A third flaw is still unfixed.
